answer.rationale: Primary region write latency is 5x target and climbing; the degradation is regionally isolated. Regional failover succeeded in the March event (memory_b2) with clean traffic shift and sub-minute recovery. Rollback is blocked by compliance on the security patch. Circuit breakers and read routing address symptoms but not the root write path issue under peak settlement load. Capacity addition is slower to take effect. Failover to a healthy region preserves the mandatory security patch, maintains write durability during peak settlement traffic, and has proven execution precedent. Verification of memory_b2 confirms the mechanism worked at scale before; confidence in this action path is high given the isolated primary-region symptom pattern.
